title: Dream Seeker: a bucket list you finish step by step
description: Pick a dream and the small steps to get there become the teeth of a key. Answer one question at a time, finish the key, and open the treasure box.

problem.title: Ever written a bucket list and forgotten it?
problem.text: "See the Northern Lights" is so big you don't know where to start, so it sits on the list for years. Dream Seeker breaks it into steps you can do today, like checking the season, saving up and booking flights, and only shows you the one to work on now.

features.title: Choose from more than 590 dreams
features.text:
Travel, experiences, achievements, health, learning and relationships. Dreams from six areas float by in boxes on the Dream Ocean. Bring one to your workshop and its steps are already laid out.
Don't see yours? Make your own with a title, an area and the steps it takes.

features.title: One tooth at a time, just enough for today
features.text:
My Workshop shows how far each dream's key has come. The step to do now sits at the top, and answering its questions fills one tooth.
Your answers and photos collect in My Notes, and the Progress Timeline lets you look back on the whole way.

features.title: Achieved dreams go to the Treasury, places go on the map
features.text:
Fill every tooth and open the box. Achieved dreams pile up in the Treasury with their dates, and paused dreams wait there until you pick them back up.
Dreams tied to a place show up on the map, so you can see everywhere you want to go.

items.title: Pick a dream
items.text: Tap a box on the Dream Ocean and choose Bring to My Workshop.

items.title: Answer today's step
items.text: Answer the questions on the step at the top, one by one, to fill a tooth.

items.title: Open the box
items.text: When every tooth is filled the key is done and the box opens.

reference.title: Six areas on the Dream Ocean
rows: See the Northern Lights in Iceland · Watch the sunset in Santorini
Run a full marathon · Trek to Everest Base Camp
Become fluent in English · Become fluent in French
Travel the world with your parents · Spend a month on Jeju Island with friends
reference.note: Each area holds close to a hundred dreams. Make your own with Add New Dream in My Workshop.

items.a: On the Dream Ocean tab, tap a box you like and choose Bring to My Workshop. In My Workshop, answer the questions on the current step and the teeth fill in one by one. Fill them all to open the box.

items.q: Can I add my own dream?
items.a: Yes. In My Workshop, tap Add New Dream and enter a title, an area and the steps to get there.

items.q: How do I pause a dream or pick it back up?
items.a: In an active dream's menu, choose Give Up This Dream and it moves to Paused Dreams in the Treasury. Tap Restart there to bring it back to My Workshop, or Delete Forever to remove it.
A screen that manages your dreams like climbing a mountain. Turn it on or off in Settings > Display. You can track deadlines per step and obstacles like cost and time, project-style.
Some dream backgrounds are downloaded from the internet. Check that you're online. Without a connection, a default picture is shown.

items.q: Can I move my notes to a new iPhone?
items.a: Your notes are stored only on this device, with no account or sync. Restoring a new iPhone from an iCloud or computer backup brings them along with your other app data.

items.q: Is there anything to buy inside the app?
items.a: No. Once you have the app, every feature is yours. The tips in Settings are only there if you'd like to say thanks.

items.q: Are my dreams and notes sent anywhere?
items.a: No. There's no account, and no ads or analytics. Your dreams, notes and photos stay on your device.
Bug reports, ideas, anything at all. Send them from Send Feedback in the app's Settings, or by Instagram DM (@lee25_ios).
